t: 斯地利乔角所辖的西罗马军队,在法埃苏莱战役中击败了奥斯特罗哥特军队.
te: The Western Roman army under Stilicho corners and defeats the Ostrogothic army in the battle of Faesulae.
dz: 斯地利乔角所辖的西罗马军队,在法埃苏莱战役中击败了奥斯特罗哥特军队.
de: The Western Roman army under Stilicho corners and defeats the Ostrogothic army in the battle of Faesulae.

t: 万道尔斯,艾伦斯和苏比亚人穿越了莱茵河,开始入侵高卢.
te: Vandals, Alans and Suebians cross the Rhine, beginning an invasion of Gaul.
dz: 万道尔斯,艾伦斯和苏比亚人穿越了莱茵河,开始入侵高卢.
de: Vandals, Alans and Suebians cross the Rhine, beginning an invasion of Gaul.
